disease_mutation_row_level.name: disease_mutation_row_level
disease_mutation_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,
  dm.chromosome_id AS chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos AS chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt AS ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt AS alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id AS ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos AS cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos AS peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb AS aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa AS ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa AS alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq AS mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source AS data_source,
  dm.doid AS doid
FROM disease_mutation dm
disease_mutation_row_level.description: Row-level view exposing all columns of disease_mutation for filtering and selection. Useful as the base cohort for queries about individual mutations.
validated_on: Show me all information about disease mutations with amino acid residue (ref_aa) equal to E
counter_examples: Show disease mutation chromosome positions for skin cancer

disease_mutation_with_tissue_and_article.name: disease_mutation_with_tissue_and_articles
disease_mutation_with_tissue_and_article.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source,
  dm.doid,
  dmt.uberon_anatomical_id AS "disease_mutation_tissue.uberon_anatomical_id",
  dma.pmid AS "disease_mutation_article.pmid"
FROM disease_mutation_row_level dm
LEFT JOIN disease_mutation_tissue dmt
  ON dmt.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
LEFT JOIN disease_mutation_article dma
  ON dma.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
disease_mutation_with_tissue_and_article.description: Denormalized mutation-level view joining disease_mutation to related tissue and article associations to support questions that need mutation context (tissue uberon id(s), related pmids). One row per disease_mutation.id; multiple tissue or article rows will duplicate mutation rows (preserves row-level detail).

disease_mutation_prediction_and_annotati.name: disease_mutation_prediction_and_annotation
disease_mutation_prediction_and_annotati.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos,

  dmp.site_prediction           AS "disease_mutation_impact_prediction.site_prediction",

FROM

    ON dma.disease_mutation_id = dm.id
disease_mutation_prediction_and_annotati.description: Mutation-level view joining disease_mutation to its impact predictions and site annotations. One row per disease_mutation.id per linked prediction/annotation (keeps raw prediction rows for later aggregation or filtering by tool/feature).

fda_test_rowlevel.name: fda_test_rowlevel
fda_test_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  test_submission,
  test_trade_name,

FROM biomarker_fda_test
fda_test_rowlevel.description: One row per FDA test from biomarker_fda_test exposing test identifiers and key attributes for filtering and counting.

fda_test_with_fda_metadata.name: fda_test_with_fda_metadata
fda_test_with_fda_metadata.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.test_submission AS test_submission,
  t.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,
  t.test_manufacturer AS test_manufacturer,
  -- pull biomarker_origin and test_number_genes from biomarker_fda_test (if available)
  bft.biomarker_origin AS biomarker_origin,
  bft.test_number_genes AS test_number_genes,
  t.test_approval_status AS test_approval_status,
  -- aggregate distinct drugs linked via biomarker_fda_drug for this biomarker_fda.id (biomarker_fda.id = bfd.biomarker_fda_id)
  COALESCE(
    string_agg(DISTINCT bfd.biomarker_drug, E'; ' ORDER BY bfd.biomarker_drug),
    ''
  ) AS test_drugs,
  -- aggregate distinct NCIt biomarker terms linked via biomarker_fda_ncit_term
  COALESCE(
    string_agg(DISTINCT bfn.ncit_biomarker, E'; ' ORDER BY bfn.ncit_biomarker),
    ''
  ) AS ncit_biomarkers
FROM
  fda_test_rowlevel t
  -- join to biomarker_fda_test to fetch extended test metadata (match on test_submission and test_trade_name)
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test bft
    ON bft.test_submission = t.test_submission
    AND bft.test_trade_name = t.test_trade_name
  -- biomarker_fda links tests to biomarker_fda.id via test_trade_name/test_submission
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda bf
    ON bf.test_trade_name = t.test_trade_name
    AND bf.test_submission = t.test_submission
  -- drugs for the biomarker_fda entry
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_drug bfd
    ON bfd.biomarker_fda_id = bf.id
  -- ncit terms for the biomarker_fda entry
  LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_ncit_term bfn
    ON bfn.biomarker_fda_id = bf.id
GROUP BY
  t.test_submission,
  t.test_trade_name,
  t.test_manufacturer,
  bft.biomarker_origin,
  bft.test_number_genes,
  t.test_approval_status
fda_test_with_fda_metadata.description: Denormalized FDA test rows joined with linked biomarker_fda and related drug/ncit terms for broader queries about tests and their linked metadata.

species_row.name: species_row
species_row.body_sql:

species_genus_projection.name: species_genus_projection
species_genus_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- carry the key so the view is joinable by speciesid
  s.speciesid,
  -- canonicalize/trims: lower-case the genus and speciescommonname, trim whitespace,
  -- collapse internal multiple spaces to single, and NULL -> empty string for presentation/filtering.
  -- Lifted literals: none (no question-specific literals needed).
  NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(trim(coalesce(s.genus, ''))), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), '') AS genus,
  NULLIF(regexp_replace(lower(trim(coalesce(s.speciescommonname, ''))), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), '') AS speciescommonname
FROM species s
species_genus_projection.description: Canonical projection of species table with trimmed/canonicalized genus and common name for filtering and presentation.

disease_mutation_with_disease.name: disease_mutation_with_disease
disease_mutation_with_disease.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,
  dm.chromosome_id AS chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos AS chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt AS ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt AS alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id AS ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos AS cds_pos,

disease_mutation_transcript_map.name: disease_mutation_transcript_map
disease_mutation_transcript_map.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,
  -- prefer the ensembl_transcript_id from the disease_mutation row itself
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id AS ensembl_transcript_id,
  mpdm.peptide_id AS peptide_id,
  mpdm.uniprotkb_ac AS uniprotkb_ac,
  muc.uniprotkb_canonical_ac AS uniprotkb_canonical_ac
FROM
  disease_mutation_row_level dm
  LEFT JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mpdm
    ON dm.ensembl_transcript_id IS NOT NULL
    AND mpdm.ensembl_transcript_id = dm.ensembl_transcript_id
  LEFT JOIN map_uniprot_canonical_id muc
    ON mpdm.uniprotkb_ac IS NOT NULL
    AND muc.uniprotkb_ac = mpdm.uniprotkb_ac
disease_mutation_transcript_map.description: Map disease mutations to protein/Uniprot identifiers via ensembl_transcript_id to support questions joining mutations to protein resources. One row per disease_mutation (uses map_protein_disease_mutation where available).

FROM
  biomarker_fda_test t
fda_tests_normalized.description: Canonicalized FDA test rows exposing key identifiers and normalized manufacturer string for exact-match and case-sensitive filtering; one row per test (trade name + submission) as represented in biomarker_fda_test.

fda_test_trial_counts_by_test.name: fda_test_trial_counts_by_test

FROM

  ON f.test_trade_name = t.test_trade_name

GROUP BY
  f.test_trade_name,

disease_with_mutation_counts.name: disease_with_mutation_counts
disease_with_mutation_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id AS id,
  d.name AS name,
  COALESCE(dm_counts.mutation_count, 0) AS mutation_count,
  COALESCE(dm_counts.distinct_chromosomes, 0) AS distinct_chromosomes,
  COALESCE(dm_counts.max_mutation_freq, 0) AS max_mutation_freq
FROM
  disease d
LEFT JOIN (
  -- disease-level aggregated mutation measures
  SELECT
    doid AS doid,
    COUNT(*) AS mutation_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT chromosome_id) AS distinct_chromosomes,
    MAX(mutation_freq) AS max_mutation_freq
  FROM
    -- lift any literal filters out (none needed here) and use the canonical row-level mutation view
    disease_mutation_row_level
  WHERE
    doid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    doid
) dm_counts
  ON d.id = dm_counts.doid
disease_with_mutation_counts.description: Per-disease counts of related mutations and basic mutation-derived measures. Useful for questions that need disease-level mutation summaries.

biomarker_edrn_phase_lookup.name: biomarker_edrn_phase_lookup
biomarker_edrn_phase_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  biomarker_title,
  qa_state,
  phase AS phase,
  -- canonical_phase: normalize common phase text to small set of categories
  CASE
    WHEN phase IS NULL OR btrim(phase) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'phase\\s*0|phase0|preclinical|pre-clinical|nonclinical' THEN 'preclinical'
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'phase\\s*i+\\b|phase\\s*1\\b|phase\\s*1/2|phase\\s*1-2' THEN 'phase 1'
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'phase\\s*2\\b|phase\\s*2/3|phase\\s*2-3' THEN 'phase 2'
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'phase\\s*3\\b|phase\\s*3/4|phase\\s*3-4' THEN 'phase 3'
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'phase\\s*4\\b|post[- ]marketing|postmarketing' THEN 'phase 4'
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'clinical trial|clinical' THEN 'clinical'
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'research|pilot|exploratory' THEN 'research'
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'approved|approval|approved by|cleared|cleared by|fda approved' THEN 'approved'
    WHEN lower(phase) ~ 'withdrawn|terminated|suspended' THEN 'stopped'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS canonical_phase,
  -- qa_state_normalized: canonicalize qa_state into a small controlled set
  CASE
    WHEN qa_state IS NULL OR btrim(qa_state) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN lower(qa_state) IN ('approved', 'final', 'published', 'released') THEN 'approved'
    WHEN lower(qa_state) IN ('draft', 'in progress', 'in_progress', 'in-review', 'in review') THEN 'draft'
    WHEN lower(qa_state) IN ('provisional', 'preliminary') THEN 'provisional'
    WHEN lower(qa_state) IN ('retired', 'deprecated', 'withdrawn') THEN 'retired'
    WHEN lower(qa_state) IN ('qa failed', 'failed', 'rejected') THEN 'rejected'
    ELSE lower(qa_state)
  END AS qa_state_normalized
FROM biomarker_edrn
biomarker_edrn_phase_lookup.description: Normalized projection of biomarker_edrn with cleaned phase and canonical qa_state; exposes raw phase for filtering and canonicalized values for downstream grouping. One row per biomarker_edrn.id.

biomarker_edrn_core_26.name: biomarker_edrn_core_26

biomarker_basic_identifiers.name: biomarker_basic_identifiers
biomarker_basic_identifiers.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_id,
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM
  biomarker b
UNION
-- include aliases: map alias values to the canonical biomarker id (biomarker_internal_id -> biomarker.id)
SELECT
  ba.biomarker_internal_id AS id,
  NULL::character varying AS gene_symbol,
  ba.alias AS biomarker_id,
  NULL::boolean AS test_is_a_panel
FROM
  biomarker_alias ba
WHERE
  ba.biomarker_internal_id IS NOT NULL
biomarker_basic_identifiers.description: Canonical identifiers and names for biomarkers from the biomarker table and common alias crosswalks; exposes primary id, gene symbol, human-readable id fields, and whether the test is a panel. Useful to join with EDRN records or FDA tests.

biomarker_fda_test_summary.description: Denormalized per-test FDA information: one row per distinct FDA test trade name + submission, exposing manufacturer, approval status, platform, gene count, and clinical significance. Useful to relate biomarkers to FDA-approved tests and filter by test attributes.

biomarker_row_level.name: biomarker_row_level
biomarker_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_id,
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM biomarker b
biomarker_row_level.description: Row-level view exposing each biomarker record and key attributes for filtering, grouping, and projection. Does not aggregate; intended as the base cohort for biomarker-focused questions.

biomarker_gene_symbol_canonicalized.name: biomarker_gene_symbol_canonicalized
biomarker_gene_symbol_canonicalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  -- canonicalized: trim whitespace and uppercase; preserve NULL if original is NULL
  CASE
    WHEN b.gene_symbol IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE upper(trim(b.gene_symbol))
  END AS gene_symbol_canonical,
  -- missing flag: true when gene_symbol is NULL or, after trimming, is the empty string
  CASE
    WHEN b.gene_symbol IS NULL THEN true
    WHEN trim(b.gene_symbol) = '' THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS gene_symbol_is_missing
FROM biomarker b
biomarker_gene_symbol_canonicalized.description: Normalized projection of biomarker gene symbols with simple canonicalization (trimmed, upper-cased) and a flag for null/empty gene_symbol. Useful for de-duplicating gene symbols across queries.

biomarker_to_aliases.name: biomarker_to_aliases
biomarker_to_aliases.body_sql:
SELECT
  ba.biomarker_internal_id,
  ba.alias,
  b.biomarker_id,
  b.gene_symbol
FROM biomarker_alias ba
LEFT JOIN biomarker b
  ON ba.biomarker_internal_id = b.id
UNION ALL
-- include primary gene_symbol as an alias-like row so searching by gene_symbol finds the biomarker
SELECT
  b.id AS biomarker_internal_id,
  b.gene_symbol AS alias,
  b.biomarker_id,
  b.gene_symbol
FROM biomarker b
WHERE b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
biomarker_to_aliases.description: Denormalized mapping of biomarkers to their aliases (one row per biomarker alias). Useful when queries need to find biomarkers by either primary gene_symbol or any alias.

biomarker_edrn_type_summary.name: biomarker_edrn_type_summary
biomarker_edrn_type_summary.body_sql:
SELECT

  COUNT(id) AS biomarker_count
FROM biomarker_edrn
GROUP BY biomarker_type, phase
biomarker_edrn_type_summary.description: Aggregated counts of EDRN biomarkers by biomarker_type and phase (one row per biomarker_type + phase). Useful for rapid cohort sizing and faceted filtering.

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_34.name: biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_34
biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_34.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.qa_state AS qa_state,
  b.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  b.biomarker_type AS biomarker_type,
  b.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  b.phase AS phase,
  a.name AS "anatomical_entity.name",
  a.description AS "anatomical_entity.description"
FROM

LEFT JOIN
  anatomical_entity a
ON
  b.uberon_anatomical_id = a.id
biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_34.description: Denormalized view joining EDRN biomarkers to anatomical entity metadata via uberon_anatomical_id. One row per biomarker_edrn record augmented with anatomy name/description for richer filtering and display.

biomarker_type_distribution.name: biomarker_type_distribution
biomarker_type_distribution.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM

biomarker_type_distribution.description: Counts of biomarker_edrn records grouped by biomarker_type to support analytics and quickly answer type-based cohort sizes.

cancer_tissue_by_uberon.name: cancer_tissue_by_uberon
cancer_tissue_by_uberon.body_sql:
SELECT

cancer_tissue_by_uberon.description: One row per cancer tissue mapping linking DOID (disease ontology id) to an UBERON anatomical id representing the tissue site for a cancer.

healthy_expression_by_uberon_gene.name: healthy_expression_by_uberon_gene
healthy_expression_by_uberon_gene.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM healthy_expression
healthy_expression_by_uberon_gene.description: Gene-level healthy expression records per anatomical site (UBERON). Exposes gene symbol or ensembl id with relative expression metrics for downstream filtering and joining to cancer tissue or gene cross-reference tables.

gene_symbol_ensembl_lookup.name: gene_symbol_ensembl_lookup
gene_symbol_ensembl_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT

WHERE x.ensembl_gene_id IS NOT NULL

gene_symbol_ensembl_lookup.description: Map between gene_symbol and ensembl_gene_id for supported species, to enable returning gene symbol and Ensembl id when available.

biomarker_core_39.name: biomarker_core_39

biomarker_core_39.description: Canonical projection of biomarker identity and descriptive fields, one row per biomarker. Exposes stable identifiers and text fields useful for text-matching and joins to other biomarker-related tables.

biomarker_to_disease_text_association.name: biomarker_to_disease_text_association
biomarker_to_disease_text_association.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  -- which field contained the disease term; lifted literal: 'disease_term'
  CASE
    WHEN b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND b.gene_symbol ILIKE '%' || 'disease_term' || '%' THEN 'gene_symbol'
    WHEN b.biomarker_description IS NOT NULL AND b.biomarker_description ILIKE '%' || 'disease_term' || '%' THEN 'biomarker_description'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS match_field,
  -- the snippet of text that matched: prefer gene_symbol exact match, else entire biomarker_description
  CASE
    WHEN b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND b.gene_symbol ILIKE '%' || 'disease_term' || '%' THEN b.gene_symbol
    WHEN b.biomarker_description IS NOT NULL AND b.biomarker_description ILIKE '%' || 'disease_term' || '%' THEN b.biomarker_description
    ELSE NULL
  END AS match_text
FROM
  biomarker b
WHERE
  (
    b.gene_symbol IS NOT NULL AND b.gene_symbol ILIKE '%' || 'disease_term' || '%'
  )
  OR
  (
    b.biomarker_description IS NOT NULL AND b.biomarker_description ILIKE '%' || 'disease_term' || '%'
  )
biomarker_to_disease_text_association.description: A lightweight text-cohort of biomarkers that mention a given disease term in either gene_symbol or biomarker_description. One row per biomarker; intended as a fallback when no explicit biomarker<->disease join exists in the schema.

edrn_biomarker_phase_counts.name: edrn_biomarker_phase_counts
edrn_biomarker_phase_counts.body_sql:
SELECT
  coalesce(b.phase, 'unknown') AS phase,
  count(DISTINCT b.id) AS biomarker_count
FROM
  biomarker_edrn b
GROUP BY
  coalesce(b.phase, 'unknown')
ORDER BY
  biomarker_count DESC
edrn_biomarker_phase_counts.description: Count of biomarkers grouped by EDRN phase. Useful for summaries and ordering by prevalence of phases.

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_43.name: biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_43
biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_43.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,

  b.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  a.id AS "anatomical_entity.id",
  a.name AS "anatomical_entity.name"
FROM
  biomarker_edrn b
LEFT JOIN

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_43.description: EDRN biomarkers joined to anatomical entity via uberon_anatomical_id to support phase-by-anatomy analysis.

fda_tests_rowlevel.name: fda_tests_rowlevel
fda_tests_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,

  test_manufacturer AS test_manufacturer,

FROM biomarker_fda_test
fda_tests_rowlevel.description: Row-level cohort of FDA biomarker tests (one row per test submission + trade name) with key identifying and descriptive columns for filtering and reporting.

fda_test_with_fda_and_drug_terms.name: fda_test_with_fda_and_drug_terms
fda_test_with_fda_and_drug_terms.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,
  t.test_submission AS test_submission,
  t.test_manufacturer AS test_manufacturer,
  t.platform_method AS platform_method,
  t.test_study_design AS test_study_design,
  bfd.biomarker_drug AS biomarker_drug,
  bfn.ncit_biomarker AS ncit_biomarker
FROM biomarker_fda_test t
-- left join to biomarker_fda_test_use is not required for requested columns, join drug and ncit mapping tables
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda fda ON fda.id = t.test_submission
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_drug bfd ON bfd.biomarker_fda_id = fda.id
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_ncit_term bfn ON bfn.biomarker_fda_id = fda.id
fda_test_with_fda_and_drug_terms.description: Denormalized view joining FDA test core info to related FDA biomarker-drug and NCIt biomarker term mappings, one row per test submission + trade name + mapping (if any). Useful when exploring test->drug or test->ncit relationships alongside test metadata.

differential_expression_rows.name: differential_expression_rows
differential_expression_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.pvalue AS pvalue,
  d.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  d.doid AS doid,
  d.log2fc AS log2fc,
  d.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
  d.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
  d.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction
FROM

differential_expression_rows.description: Row-level view of differential expression results (one row per gene-disease combination) exposing raw statistics and keys for joining to disease metadata.
validated_on: Return gen symbol and pvalue for the expression of gene with symbol 'EGFR' in lung cancer

differential_expression_with_disease.name: differential_expression_with_disease
differential_expression_with_disease.body_sql:
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  de.doid AS doid,
  de.pvalue AS pvalue,
  de.log2fc AS log2fc,
  de.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
  de.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
  de.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction,
  d.name AS disease_name
FROM differential_expression de
LEFT JOIN disease d
  ON de.doid = d.id
differential_expression_with_disease.description: Denormalized view joining differential_expression to disease so filters on disease name and retrieval of expression p-values can be done directly.

mutation_with_disease_join.name: mutation_with_disease_join
mutation_with_disease_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,
  dm.chromosome_id AS chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos AS chromosome_pos,
  dm.doid AS doid,
  d.id AS disease_id,
  d.name AS disease_name
FROM disease_mutation_row_level dm
LEFT JOIN disease d
  ON dm.doid = d.id
mutation_with_disease_join.description: Denormalized view joining disease_mutation to disease to provide mutation location alongside disease name and id. One row per mutation, with disease fields included for filtering and presentation.

disease_mutation_with_disease_49.name: disease_mutation_with_disease_49
disease_mutation_with_disease_49.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id                                                                         AS "disease_mutation.id",
  dm.chromosome_id                                                              AS "disease_mutation.chromosome_id",
  dm.chromosome_pos                                                             AS "disease_mutation.chromosome_pos",
  dm.ref_nt                                                                     AS "disease_mutation.ref_nt",
  dm.alt_nt                                                                     AS "disease_mutation.alt_nt",
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id                                                      AS "disease_mutation.ensembl_transcript_id",
  dm.cds_pos                                                                    AS "disease_mutation.cds_pos",
  dm.peptide_pos                                                                AS "disease_mutation.peptide_pos",
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb                                                           AS "disease_mutation.aa_pos_uniprotkb",
  dm.ref_aa                                                                     AS "disease_mutation.ref_aa",
  dm.alt_aa                                                                     AS "disease_mutation.alt_aa",
  dm.mutation_freq                                                              AS "disease_mutation.mutation_freq",
  dm.data_source                                                                AS "disease_mutation.data_source",
  d.id                                                                          AS "disease.id AS disease_id",
  d.name                                                                        AS "disease.name AS disease_name"
FROM
  disease_mutation dm
LEFT JOIN
  disease d
ON
  dm.doid = d.id
disease_mutation_with_disease_49.description: Denormalized join of disease_mutation to disease producing one row per disease_mutation.id with associated disease.id and disease.name to support queries that filter or report mutations by disease name.

disease_mutation_with_transcript_map.name: disease_mutation_with_transcript_map
disease_mutation_with_transcript_map.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  /* lift literal: prefer ensembl_transcript_id from disease_mutation; NULL if not present */
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
  /* uniprotkb_ac comes from map_protein_disease_mutation joined by ensembl_transcript_id */
  mp.uniprotkb_ac,
  dm.cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source,
  dm.doid
FROM
  disease_mutation dm
  LEFT JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mp
    ON dm.ensembl_transcript_id = mp.ensembl_transcript_id
disease_mutation_with_transcript_map.description: Denormalized view joining disease_mutation to transcript/protein mapping (if available) to expose UniProt and Ensembl transcript identifiers alongside mutation metadata for downstream filtering and joins.

disease_mutation_counts_by_ref_aa.name: disease_mutation_counts_by_ref_aa
disease_mutation_counts_by_ref_aa.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.doid AS doid,
  dm.ref_aa AS ref_aa,
  COUNT(*)::bigint AS mutation_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dm.ensembl_transcript_id) FILTER (WHERE dm.ensembl_transcript_id IS NOT NULL)::bigint AS distinct_transcript_count
FROM
  disease_mutation_row_level dm
GROUP BY
  dm.doid,
  dm.ref_aa
disease_mutation_counts_by_ref_aa.description: Aggregate counts of disease_mutation rows grouped by reference amino acid (ref_aa) and disease (doid). Useful for quick cohort sizes and prevalence checks per residue and disease.

fda_tests_rowlevel_52.name: fda_tests_rowlevel_52
fda_tests_rowlevel_52.body_sql:
SELECT
  test_submission,
  test_trade_name,
  test_manufacturer,
  test_approval_status,
  test_number_genes,
  platform_method
FROM
  biomarker_fda_test
fda_tests_rowlevel_52.description: Row-level cohort of FDA tests (one row per FDA test submission) with key identity and common descriptive fields, useful as the base cohort for counts, filters by manufacturer, approval status, or other attributes.

fda_tests_manufacturer_normalized.name: fda_tests_manufacturer_normalized
fda_tests_manufacturer_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.test_submission AS test_submission,
  t.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,
  -- normalized manufacturer: trim whitespace; treat empty-string as NULL
  NULLIF(btrim(t.test_manufacturer), '') AS test_manufacturer_normalized
FROM
  -- source: use provided row-level view for FDA tests
  fda_test_rowlevel AS t
fda_tests_manufacturer_normalized.description: Normalized/cleaned projection of FDA tests focusing on manufacturer canonicalization (trim/NULL normalization) and exposing the manufacturer as a searchable dimension alongside test identity.

fda_test_with_fda_and_drug_terms_54.name: fda_test_with_fda_and_drug_terms_54
fda_test_with_fda_and_drug_terms_54.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.test_submission,
  t.test_trade_name,
  t.test_manufacturer,
  bfd.biomarker_drug,
  bfn.ncit_biomarker
FROM
  biomarker_fda_test AS t
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test_use AS use ON
  use.test_submission = t.test_submission
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda AS fda ON
  fda.test_submission = t.test_submission
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_drug AS bfd ON
  bfd.biomarker_fda_id = fda.id
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_ncit_term AS bfn ON
  bfn.biomarker_fda_id = fda.id
fda_test_with_fda_and_drug_terms_54.description: Denormalized FDA test rows joined to related FDA biomarker/drug and NCIT term tables to support queries that need test metadata plus associated drugs or NCIT biomarker terms. One row per test_submission per associated drug/term (may duplicate test_submission if multiple associations).

differential_expression_by_gene_and_dise.name: differential_expression_by_gene_and_disease
differential_expression_by_gene_and_dise.body_sql:
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  de.doid AS doid,
  de.log2fc AS log2fc,
  de.pvalue AS pvalue,
  de.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
  de.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
  de.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction,
  COALESCE(de.subjects_up, 0) AS subjects_up,
  COALESCE(de.subjects_down, 0) AS subjects_down,
  -- carry subjects_total through; if null, compute from components when possible
  COALESCE(
    de.subjects_total,
    -- if subjects_total missing but up/down known, sum them (ignore nochange/nocoverage)
    NULLIF(COALESCE(de.subjects_up, 0) + COALESCE(de.subjects_down, 0), 0),
    NULL
  ) AS subjects_total
FROM
  differential_expression de
differential_expression_by_gene_and_dise.description: Row-level differential expression measurements for each gene in each disease (disease ontology id), including effect direction and significance flags.
validated_on: Return the symbol and p-value for the expression of EGFR in lung cancer
Show the pvalue of differential expression of lung cancer

disease_core_56.name: disease_core_56
disease_core_56.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id AS id,
  d.name AS name
FROM

WHERE

disease_core_56.description: Canonical disease records with id and human-readable name; filters out NULL names to ensure downstream joins return meaningful labels.

gene_upregulated_diseases_join.name: gene_upregulated_diseases_join
gene_upregulated_diseases_join.body_sql:
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  de.doid AS doid,
  d.name AS disease_name,
  de.log2fc AS log2fc,
  de.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
  de.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
  de.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction
FROM
  differential_expression de
JOIN
  disease d
  ON de.doid = d.id
WHERE
  de.expression_change_direction = 'increased'
gene_upregulated_diseases_join.description: Denormalized view joining differential expression rows to disease names for up-/increased-expression measurements, exposing one row per (gene_symbol, disease.id) with both measurement and disease name.

species_text_cleaning.name: species_text_cleaning
species_text_cleaning.body_sql:
SELECT
  speciesid,
  NULLIF(trim(genus), '') AS genus_norm,
  NULLIF(trim(species), '') AS species_norm,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(speciescommonname), ''), '') AS speciescommonname_norm
FROM species
species_text_cleaning.description: Normalized textual variants for species names: trimmed and null-normalized genus, species, and common name to support consistent text matching and joins.

species_minimal_projection.name: species_minimal_projection
species_minimal_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  species.speciesid AS speciesid,
  species.genus AS genus,
  species.speciescommonname AS species
FROM species
species_minimal_projection.description: Lean projection exposing only key and display name(s) for quick lookups, faceting, and joins; no filters baked in.

canonical_gene_to_ensembl_mapping.name: canonical_gene_to_ensembl_mapping
canonical_gene_to_ensembl_mapping.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(x.gene_symbol, h_gene_symbol) AS gene_symbol,
  x.ensembl_gene_id,
  x.speciesid
FROM xref_gene_ensembl x
LEFT JOIN (
  -- fallback: if gene_symbol is NULL in xref, try to derive a symbol from healthy_expression via ensembl id
  -- lift literal(s) out of view: none required here
  SELECT
    ensembl_gene_id,
    NULL::character varying AS h_gene_symbol
  FROM healthy_expression
  GROUP BY ensembl_gene_id
) he ON he.ensembl_gene_id = x.ensembl_gene_id
canonical_gene_to_ensembl_mapping.description: Mapping from gene symbol to Ensembl gene id and species context. Useful to normalize/resolve gene identifiers when questions refer to genes by symbol or Ensembl id.

canonical_gene_symbol_by_ensembl_and_xre.name: canonical_gene_symbol_by_ensembl_and_xref
canonical_gene_symbol_by_ensembl_and_xre.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(x.gene_symbol, xref.gene_symbol) AS gene_symbol,
  COALESCE(x.ensembl_gene_id, xref.ensembl_gene_id) AS ensembl_gene_id,
  xref.speciesid AS speciesid
FROM
  -- primary canonical mapping from xref_gene_ensembl (ensembl -> canonical gene_symbol for species)
  xref_gene_ensembl xref
  -- try to prefer any directly reported mapping where gene_symbol on xref matches a reported gene_symbol in other tables
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      gene_symbol,
      ensembl_gene_id
    FROM xref_gene_ensembl
  ) x
    ON xref.ensembl_gene_id = x.ensembl_gene_id
WHERE
  -- lift question-specific literals out: none required; ensure one row per ensembl_gene_id by grouping
  TRUE
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(x.gene_symbol, xref.gene_symbol),
  COALESCE(x.ensembl_gene_id, xref.ensembl_gene_id),
  xref.speciesid
canonical_gene_symbol_by_ensembl_and_xre.description: Mapping between reported gene_symbol and canonical ensembl_gene_id along with species, to normalize gene identifiers across tables.

disease_mutation_with_tissue_doid.name: disease_mutation_with_tissue_doid
disease_mutation_with_tissue_doid.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,
  dm.chromosome_id AS chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos AS chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt AS ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt AS alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id AS ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos AS cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos AS peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb AS aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa AS ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa AS alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq AS mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source AS data_source,
  dm.doid AS doid,
  d.name AS disease_name,
  ct.uberon_anatomical_id AS cancer_uberon_anatomical_id
FROM disease_mutation dm
LEFT JOIN disease d
  ON dm.doid = d.id
LEFT JOIN cancer_tissue ct
  ON dm.doid = ct.doid
disease_mutation_with_tissue_doid.description: Denormalized disease mutation rows joined to disease id/name and to cancer_tissue by doid where available, exposing mutation details plus disease name and tissue uberon id to support queries that filter by disease or tissue.

disease_mutation_transcript_map_63.name: disease_mutation_transcript_map_63
disease_mutation_transcript_map_63.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS id,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id AS ensembl_transcript_id,
  mp.peptide_id AS peptide_id,
  mp.uniprotkb_ac AS uniprotkb_ac,
  mu.uniprotkb_canonical_ac AS uniprotkb_canonical_ac
FROM
  -- base disease mutation rows provide the mutation-level id and ensembl_transcript_id
  disease_mutation_row_level dm
  -- left join to mapping table from transcript -> peptide and Uniprot accession
  LEFT JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mp
    ON mp.ensembl_transcript_id = dm.ensembl_transcript_id
  -- left join to mapping of Uniprot accession -> canonical accession
  LEFT JOIN map_uniprot_canonical_id mu
    ON mu.uniprotkb_ac = mp.uniprotkb_ac
disease_mutation_transcript_map_63.description: Maps disease mutation ensembl_transcript_id to peptide and UniProt identifiers when available, exposing mutation-level keys plus mapped protein identifiers to support downstream joins or filtering on protein ids.

healthy_expression_rows_with_development.name: healthy_expression_rows_with_developmental_stage_id
healthy_expression_rows_with_development.body_sql:
SELECT
  he.ensembl_gene_id,
  he.uberon_anatomical_id,
  he.uberon_developmental_id,
  s.name AS stage_name
FROM
  healthy_expression he
  LEFT JOIN stage s
    ON he.uberon_developmental_id = s.id
healthy_expression_rows_with_development.description: Row-level healthy_expression rows annotated with the linked developmental stage id and stage name by joining healthy_expression to stage on uberon_developmental_id = stage.id.

healthy_expression_core_projection.name: healthy_expression_core_projection
healthy_expression_core_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- primary keys / grain
  ensembl_gene_id,
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  uberon_developmental_id,

  -- normalized expression measure columns (preserve existing names)
  expression_level_gene_relative,
  expression_level_anatomical_relative,
  expression_score,
  expression_rank_score,
  call_quality
FROM healthy_expression
healthy_expression_core_projection.description: Canonical projection of healthy_expression exposing primary keys and expression measure columns, with names normalized for downstream filters/aggregations.

differential_expression_significant_rows.name: differential_expression_significant_rows
differential_expression_significant_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  gene_symbol,
  doid,
  statistical_significance,
  log2fc,
  pvalue,
  adjpvalue
FROM
  differential_expression
WHERE
  -- treat any non-NULL and non-empty statistical_significance as indicating significance
  statistical_significance IS NOT NULL
  AND btrim(statistical_significance) <> ''
differential_expression_significant_rows.description: Row-level subset of differential_expression restricted to rows that indicate statistical significance (keeps all original columns). Treats any non-NULL and non-empty statistical_significance as indicating significance.

gene_to_diseases_significant_expression.name: gene_to_diseases_significant_expression
gene_to_diseases_significant_expression.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.gene_symbol                        AS gene_symbol,
  d.doid                               AS doid,
  dis.name                             AS disease_name,
  d.statistical_significance           AS statistical_significance,
  d.log2fc                             AS log2fc,
  d.pvalue                             AS pvalue,
  d.adjpvalue                          AS adjpvalue
FROM
  differential_expression d
LEFT JOIN
  disease dis
ON
  d.doid = dis.id
WHERE
  -- liftable literal: only include rows flagged as statistically significant
  d.statistical_significance = 'yes'
gene_to_diseases_significant_expression.description: Denormalized mapping of genes to diseases where that gene shows statistically significant differential expression. One row per (gene_symbol, disease id) pair, preserving expression statistics for downstream filtering and ranking.

differential_expression_significant_rows.name: differential_expression_significant_rows_68
differential_expression_significant_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  de.doid AS doid,
  de.log2fc AS log2fc,
  de.pvalue AS pvalue,
  de.adjpvalue AS adjpvalue,
  de.statistical_significance AS statistical_significance,
  de.expression_change_direction AS expression_change_direction,
  de.subjects_total AS subjects_total
FROM
  differential_expression de
WHERE
  -- lift literal for significance threshold out of the view definition
  de.statistical_significance = 'significant'
  -- optional: ensure adjpvalue exists and is below a conventional cutoff; literal kept out
  AND de.adjpvalue IS NOT NULL
differential_expression_significant_rows.description: Row-level cohort of differential expression measurements flagged as statistically significant (keeps full differential_expression row for reuse and joining).

differential_expression_with_disease_69.name: differential_expression_with_disease_69
differential_expression_with_disease_69.body_sql:
SELECT

differential_expression_with_disease_69.description: Denormalized rows combining differential expression measurements with their linked disease name (when available). One row per differential_expression (gene_symbol, doid).

biomarker_aliases_aggregated.name: biomarker_aliases_aggregated
biomarker_aliases_aggregated.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.biomarker_internal_id,
  -- lift literal for array aggregation NULL fallback (empty array)
  COALESCE(array_agg(b.alias ORDER BY b.alias) FILTER (WHERE b.alias IS NOT NULL), ARRAY[]::character varying[]) AS aliases
FROM
  biomarker_alias AS b
GROUP BY
  b.biomarker_internal_id
biomarker_aliases_aggregated.description: All aliases for each biomarker concatenated into an array-like/aggregated field. One row per biomarker.id. Keeps raw alias values so callers can filter by or display aliases without re-joining.

biomarker_publication_links.name: biomarker_publication_links
biomarker_publication_links.body_sql:
SELECT
  bA.biomarker_internal_id,
  array_agg(bA.pmid) FILTER (WHERE bA.pmid IS NOT NULL) AS pmids
FROM
  biomarker_article bA
GROUP BY
  bA.biomarker_internal_id
biomarker_publication_links.description: Aggregated list of PMIDs (articles) associated with each biomarker. One row per biomarker_internal_id with raw pmid values exposed for filtering or counting.

biomarker_nonpanel_cohort.name: biomarker_nonpanel_cohort
biomarker_nonpanel_cohort.body_sql:

  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM
  biomarker b
WHERE
  b.test_is_a_panel IS DISTINCT FROM true
biomarker_nonpanel_cohort.description: Cohort of biomarker rows that are not panels. One row per biomarker id; intended as a reusable cohort for questions that need biomarkers excluding panel tests. Keeps same columns as base for downstream selection/aggregation.

biomarker_gene_projection.name: biomarker_gene_projection
biomarker_gene_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
  b.biomarker_description AS biomarker_description,
  x.ensembl_gene_id AS ensembl_gene_id,
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM biomarker b
LEFT JOIN xref_gene_ensembl x
  ON b.gene_symbol = x.gene_symbol
biomarker_gene_projection.description: Lightweight projection joining biomarker with gene-to-ensembl mapping (when available) to expose both gene_symbol and ensembl_gene_id alongside biomarker metadata. One row per biomarker.id to support analyses that may need gene identifiers.

fda_test_use_rows.name: fda_test_use_rows
fda_test_use_rows.body_sql:

fda_test_use_rows.description: Row-level cohort of FDA test use records (one row per biomarker_fda_test_use record) exposing approved and actual use fields and join keys to FDA test metadata.

fda_test_with_use_denorm.name: fda_test_with_use_denorm
fda_test_with_use_denorm.body_sql:
SELECT
  bftu.id AS id,
  bftu.test_trade_name AS test_trade_name,
  bftu.test_submission AS test_submission,
  bftu.approved_indication AS approved_indication,

biomarker_type_phase_cohort.name: biomarker_type_phase_cohort
biomarker_type_phase_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  qa_state,
  biomarker_title,
  -- Normalize biomarker_type: trim whitespace, map empty strings to NULL, and canonicalize common casings
  CASE
    WHEN trim(coalesce(biomarker_type, '')) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- canonicalize by lowercasing then mapping known variants to a preferred display form
      -- lift literal mappings out: 'assay_type_map' could be applied here; using inline CASE for common types
      CASE lower(trim(biomarker_type))
        WHEN 'protein' THEN 'Protein'
        WHEN 'rna' THEN 'RNA'
        WHEN 'dna' THEN 'DNA'
        WHEN 'metabolite' THEN 'Metabolite'
        WHEN 'epigenetic' THEN 'Epigenetic'
        WHEN 'cellular' THEN 'Cellular'
        WHEN 'imaging' THEN 'Imaging'
        ELSE initcap(lower(trim(biomarker_type)))
      END
  END AS biomarker_type,
  -- leave uberon_anatomical_id as-is (could be NULL)
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  -- Normalize phase: trim, map empty to NULL, canonicalize common phase strings (e.g., 'i' -> 'Phase I')
  CASE
    WHEN trim(coalesce(phase, '')) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE
      CASE lower(trim(phase))
        WHEN 'phase i' THEN 'Phase I'
        WHEN 'phase ii' THEN 'Phase II'
        WHEN 'phase iii' THEN 'Phase III'
        WHEN 'phase iv' THEN 'Phase IV'
        WHEN 'i' THEN 'Phase I'
        WHEN 'ii' THEN 'Phase II'
        WHEN 'iii' THEN 'Phase III'
        WHEN 'iv' THEN 'Phase IV'
        WHEN 'preclinical' THEN 'Preclinical'
        WHEN 'na' THEN NULL
        WHEN 'n/a' THEN NULL
        ELSE initcap(lower(trim(phase)))
      END
  END AS phase
FROM biomarker_edrn
biomarker_type_phase_cohort.description: Normalized projection of biomarker_edrn with canonical text casing and NULL-cleaned fields for type and phase to support consistent filtering and grouping by biomarker_type and phase. One row per biomarker_edrn.id.

biomarker_with_anatomy.name: biomarker_with_anatomy
biomarker_with_anatomy.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  b.qa_state AS qa_state,
  b.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  b.biomarker_type AS biomarker_type,
  b.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,
  b.phase AS phase,
  a.name AS "anatomical_entity.name",
  a.description AS "anatomical_entity.description"
FROM
  biomarker_edrn b
LEFT JOIN
  anatomical_entity a
ON
  b.uberon_anatomical_id = a.id
biomarker_with_anatomy.description: Denormalized view joining biomarker_edrn to anatomical_entity by uberon_anatomical_id to provide human-readable anatomy names alongside biomarker records. One row per biomarker_edrn.id.

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_78.name: biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_78
biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_78.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id,
  b.biomarker_title,
  b.biomarker_type,

FROM

LEFT JOIN

ON

biomarker_edrn_with_anatomy_78.description: Denormalized view joining biomarker_edrn to anatomical_entity via uberon_anatomical_id to provide human-readable anatomy name for each biomarker record. One row per biomarker_edrn.id.

biomarker_phase_cohort.name: biomarker_phase_cohort
biomarker_phase_cohort.body_sql:

  id,
  phase
FROM
  biomarker_edrn
WHERE
  phase IS NOT NULL
biomarker_phase_cohort.description: Cohort view selecting non-null phase values from biomarker_edrn with one row per biomarker_edrn.id — suitable when the question cares only about phases present (de-duplication or further joins applied later).

differential_expression_with_disease_nam.name: differential_expression_with_disease_name
differential_expression_with_disease_nam.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.gene_symbol,
  d.doid,
  dis.name AS disease_name,
  d.pvalue,
  d.log2fc,
  d.adjpvalue,
  d.expression_change_direction,
  d.statistical_significance
FROM
  differential_expression d
LEFT JOIN
  disease dis
ON
  d.doid IS NOT NULL
  AND dis.id = d.doid
differential_expression_with_disease_nam.description: Denormalized differential expression joined to disease name for easy filtering by disease text and downstream aggregation. One row per gene_symbol+doid with disease name included.
